name: geocluster-opencode
description: The runtime's agent system on OpenCode 2.0: agents, prompts, plugins and their invariant tests

scripts.build: node scripts/sync-config-contracts.mjs && node scripts/build-prompts.mjs && node scripts/build-config.mjs
scripts.check: node scripts/sync-config-contracts.mjs --check && node scripts/build-prompts.mjs --check && node scripts/build-config.mjs --check
scripts.test: node --test test/config.test.mjs test/profiles.test.mjs test/plugins.test.mjs test/pdf-read.test.mjs test/voxel-agent.test.mjs test/voxel-client.test.mjs test/account-usage.test.mjs
scripts.test:invariants: node --test test/config.test.mjs test/profiles.test.mjs test/plugins.test.mjs test/pdf-read.test.mjs test/voxel-agent.test.mjs test/voxel-client.test.mjs test/account-usage.test.mjs
